body_text:
A group isomorphism is a bijective homomorphism. Its inverse is
automatically a homomorphism, so isomorphism identifies groups
with the same multiplication structure despite different
element names. An automorphism is an isomorphism from a group
to itself; automorphisms form a group under composition.
